prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one high-fidelity desktop web homepage direction comp for fcullmann.com, first viewport only
Primary request: Design a polished, human-designed “Calm Tool Library” homepage for Florian Ullmann. This is a practical modern SaaS utility platform and professional personal site, not a generic template.
Input images: Image 1 is a style and structure reference only. Borrow only the broad hierarchy of a light utility-platform canvas, slim header, concise centered introduction, category filters, and clear card grid. Do not copy its branding, logo, exact card layout, wording, icon designs, proportions, or content.
Canvas: exactly 1504 × 1046 pixels, landscape, edge-to-edge webpage with no browser chrome, no device frame, no watermark.
Scene/backdrop: cool very-light-gray #F4F5F9 page canvas; spacious centered max-width layout; crisp white surfaces; subtle 1px cool-gray borders; minimal soft shadow; restrained 14–18px corner radii.
Header: slim polished white header around 70px high. Left: simple custom text wordmark “fcullmann” with a tiny abstract indigo accent, distinctly original. Center/right navigation labels exactly “Tools”, “Projects”, “Articles”, “About”. Far right compact language utility “EN” with a globe glyph and chevron. Tools is the active item with a quiet indigo indicator. No login, registration, social icons, or invented URLs.
Introduction: compact centered block below header, never an oversized personal hero. Small eyebrow exactly “TOOLS BY FLORIAN ULLMANN”. Headline exactly “Useful tools for everyday technical work.” Supporting copy exactly “I’m Florian Ullmann, a Senior Software Engineer building focused browser tools, projects, and technical writing.” Keep this entire intro concise with generous breathing room and no portrait.
Filters: centered row of compact pill chips immediately below the intro. Labels exactly “All tools”, “Formatters”, “Encoders”, “Generators”, “Documents”. “All tools” is active in indigo; others are white with thin borders.
Main content: dominant section titled exactly “Featured Tools” with a small quiet link “Browse all tools” aligned to the right. Directly below, a precise responsive four-column grid of four equal white utility cards in one row, generous 22–24px gaps. Each card has a small colored rounded-square category glyph, a tiny uppercase category label, bold title, two-line description, and a restrained bottom action with arrow. Cards, verbatim:
1. category “FORMATTERS”; title “JSON Formatter”; description “Format, validate, and explore JSON directly in your browser.”; action “Open tool”. Indigo #5B5EE6 glyph.
2. category “ENCODERS”; title “Base64 Encoder”; description “Encode and decode text or files locally, without uploads.”; action “Open tool”. Coral #F06F4F glyph.
3. category “GENERATORS”; title “UUID Generator”; description “Generate secure UUIDs instantly with simple format options.”; action “Open tool”. Teal glyph.
4. category “ENCODERS”; title “URL Encoder”; description “Encode and decode URL components safely and quickly.”; action “Open tool”. Amber glyph.
Below the featured row: a slim, understated white planned-tool card or strip titled exactly “PDF Converter” with a document glyph, description “Convert common document formats in your browser.” and a clearly visible neutral status pill exactly “Planned”. It must not look available or clickable.
Lower fold: the next section heading “Latest Writing” and a subtle “View all articles” link begin near the bottom of the 1046px viewport, with just the upper edges of editorial cards visible to suggest continuation.
Style/medium: shippable high-fidelity desktop web UI, clean editorial SaaS design, confident contemporary sans-serif typography similar to Inter or Geist, exceptional spacing, strong information hierarchy, crisp realistic web rendering.
Color palette: #F4F5F9 canvas, white cards, dark charcoal #262A33 type, muted cool-gray secondary text, indigo #5B5EE6 and coral #F06F4F as primary category colors, restrained teal and amber secondary glyph colors.
Composition/framing: straight-on full-page screenshot; 1504px desktop layout; compact vertical rhythm that fits header, intro, filters, featured grid, planned strip, and the beginning of Latest Writing within the first viewport; lots of breathing room without empty dead space.
Text: render every quoted UI string exactly, with legible correctly spelled English typography. Do not add extra menu items, tool names, metrics, testimonials, client names, biography claims, portrait, social URLs, prices, ratings, usage counts, or fake article titles.
Constraints: distinguish the design strongly from the reference; original fcullmann visual identity; four-column card grid is the dominant content; featured working tools appear first; PDF Converter visibly marked Planned; WCAG-friendly contrast; refined focus/hover cues may be implied subtly.
Avoid: Bootstrap appearance, warm beige or sepia palette, maps, coordinates, serif display type, giant personal hero, glassmorphism, strong gradients, excessive shadows, bubbly oversized corners, dense dashboard chrome, copied heart/PDF branding, browser chrome, device frame, watermark, illegible pseudo-text.
